page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a high-density storage server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU operating at 2.5 GHz with 32 dedicated vCPUs. Memory is configured at 128.0 GB RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. A central feature of this hardware configuration is its bundled local storage array, providing 94489 GB of hard disk drive (HDD) capacity directly attached to the instance.

Network infrastructure features a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating transfer rates required for data-intensive processing across cloud environments. The instance does not include GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative resource perspective, pairing extensive HDD volume with balanced compute and memory allows high data density per node, though rotational storage media presents inherent latency tradeoffs compared to solid-state storage.

The hardware configuration of Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge makes it suitable for workloads demanding large storage capacity per instance. Recommended applications include big data analytics, distributed file system nodes, log retention pipelines, and batch processing systems that prioritize storage volume over random read-write performance.
